correctness.rationale: Define W=(S^-1+10I+S)/12 and D=S^-1-2I+S on the bi-infinite lattice; sigma>=0, A=W-sigma D has center a=5/6+2sigma and neighbors b=1/12-sigma. For sigma=0, B=A^-1 W=I. If sigma>=1/12 then b<=0 and a-2|b|=1, so inverse Green kernel of A is nonnegative; multiplying by W>=0 shows B>=0 and since B1=1 preserves all constant-bound data ranges. If 0<sigma<1/12, A^-1 kernel is C r^|j| with C=(a²-4b²)^-1/2>0 and -1<r<0; using b(r²+1)+ar=0 yields (B e0)_2=-12*C*sigma*r²/(1-12sigma)<0. This proves exact iff for the infinite lattice. Independently verified four-cycle at sigma=1/100: [13217/13568,3/212,-33/13568,3/212], whose sum is 1 and third component is negative. This finite witness only refutes unqualified finite-periodic positivity, not an all-size threshold.
